scope: Independent visual image-to-image landmark observations only. No geographic coordinates, OSM nodes, neighborhood name points or parent NCC transform were used to select these final feature measurements.
coordinateConvention: Original embedded JPEG integer pixel indices; x right/y down, no page or geography conversion.
measurementMethod: Identify the same distinctive physical roof details by eye in original JPEGs; enlarge raw crops with nearest-neighbor sampling and label original-image pixel axes. Listed uncertainty is a manual interpretation half-width, not a statistical confidence interval.

landmarks.physicalDetail: Northern tip/corner of the conspicuous bright rectangular gym-like roof, beside the dark-green rectangular courtyard. This is below the blue Erzsébetváros label in Figure73.
Center of the second dark rooftop box, counting from north, on the broad pale T/L-shaped building. The same sequence of four dark rooftop boxes is visible in both images.
Northern end of the reddish roof ridge of the small building immediately south of the large T/L-shaped building, with attached pale roofs to the east.
Northeast roof corner of the long pale rectangular shed immediately north of the wide railway corridor. The same neighboring smaller pale-blue roof and service-drive arrangement are visible.

visualFindings.strongCommonSceneEvidence: The gym/courtyard, T/L building shape and its four dark roof boxes, the small southern red-roof building, and rail-side shed/service layout correspond. The northern T/L parking outline and visible shadow directions also appear consistent at this inspection scale.
visualFindings.tonalDifference: Figure73 darkens locations outside its highlighted Belváros cells; Figure76 highlights the southern cells. Large brightness/contrast differences occur at the same physical roofs. This is a graphic overlay/tone difference and is not evidence of topographical change.
visualFindings.noGlobalTopographicOrImageDateIdentityCl: Four local correspondences do not prove unchanged geometry everywhere, a common acquisition day, or a complete image-to-image transform.

registrationDecision.ifCommonImageTransformRemainsUnproved: Use direct physically reviewed Figure76 road controls rather than silently inheriting a Figure73 geographic fit.
